trend.bedtime.comment: Track changes in sleep patterns by recording the time when the residence transitions to a sleep state, with insights indicating earlier bedtime averages over the week and month.
trend.bedtime.title: Bedtime

trend.bedtime_score.comment: Monitors the consistency of bedtime over the last 14 days, suggesting recommendations for improvement.
trend.bedtime_score.title: Bedtime Score

trend.fall_duration.comment: Amount of time detected on the ground.
trend.fall_duration.title: Fall Duration

trend.mobility_duration.comment: Tracks total time spent in motion detected by sensors, capturing state changes and significant target movements.
trend.mobility_duration.title: Time spent in motion

trend.mobility_rooms.comment: Gain insights into the daily activities of independent residents living alone by tracking room transitions every 15 minutes.
trend.mobility_rooms.title: Rooms Visited

trend.mobility_score.comment: Analyzes time spent in motion and rooms visited, providing insights into below-average mobility patterns.
trend.mobility_score.title: Mobility Score

trend.restlessness_score.comment: Measures bedroom movement during sleep using passive motion sensors.
trend.restlessness_score.title: Tranquility Score

trend.sleep_bathroom_visits.comment: Track and analyze the frequency of nighttime bathroom visits during sleep occupancy to identify patterns and highlight nights with a high number of visits.
trend.sleep_bathroom_visits.title: Bathroom Visits at Night

trend.sleep_cycle_alignment.comment: How well wake time aligns with sleep cycles
trend.sleep_cycle_alignment.title: Sleep Cycle Alignment

trend.sleep_cycle_duration.comment: Average sleep cycle length based on duration patterns
trend.sleep_cycle_duration.title: Sleep Cycle Duration

trend.sleep_duration.comment: Track and display sleep duration trends, indicating changes such as increased weekly and monthly average sleep for the resident.
trend.sleep_duration.title: Sleep Duration

trend.sleep_interruptions.comment: Number of sleep interruptions detected during the night, including motion, out-of-bed events, and other disturbances that may affect sleep quality and stability.
trend.sleep_interruptions.title: Sleep Interruptions

trend.sleep_movement.comment: Amount of time motion was detected while occupants were believed to be asleep.
trend.sleep_movement.title: Movement while Sleeping

trend.sleep_score.comment: Sleep Score trend analyzes consistency of bedtime, wakeup time, tranquility, sleep cycle alignment, and other factors to provide insights on days with below-average sleep quality, focusing on child trends like bedtime consistency, wakeup time consistency, sleep duration, wake-up time, and sleep tranquility.
trend.sleep_score.title: Sleep Score

trend.social_score.comment: Evaluates residence occupancy trends using identified visitors, occupants leaving the home, and daily check-ins, providing a score based on absence or multiple occupancy durations.
trend.social_score.title: Social Score

trend.stability_event_duration.comment: Amount of time detected as having been unstable.
trend.stability_event_duration.title: Stability Event Duration

trend.stability_score.comment: Comprehensive assessment of occupant stability based on falls, sleep quality, mobility, and other health indicators.
trend.stability_score.title: Stability Score

trend.total_falls.comment: Total falls detected each day, including fall alerts that were muted.
trend.total_falls.title: Potential Falls

trend.total_potential_falls.comment: Total pre-fall conditions detected each day that resolved without escalating to confirmed falls. These events indicate brief instability that may contribute to fall risk.
trend.total_potential_falls.title: Potential Falls (Unreported)

trend.total_stability_events.comment: Total stability events detected each day, including stability event alerts that were muted.
trend.total_stability_events.title: Potential Stability Events

trend.wakeup.comment: Track changes in sleep patterns by recording the time when the residence transitions out of a sleep state, with insights indicating later wake time averages over the week and month.
trend.wakeup.title: Wake Time

trend.wakeup_score.comment: Consistency of wake time over the last 14 days, ensuring a stable routine for better care management.
trend.wakeup_score.title: Wakeup Score

trend.wellness_score.comment: This metric assesses historical trends by scoring various lifestyle activities, including sleep, biometrics, mobility, stability, bathroom patterns, and social interactions.
trend.wellness_score.title: Wellness Score
